cases.input: Run an award-level review on a completed fantasy act after workshop and continuity review, then turn the result into a revision loop.
requiredBehaviors: run independent Hugo-, Nebula- and World-Fantasy-inspired reads before deliberation
preserve disagreements and produce a minority report
produce kill reasons and a protect list
translate evidence-backed root causes into a short prioritized revision plan
define regression checks and collateral-damage detection
freeze independent chamber reads before cross-chamber deliberation
freeze blind deliberation before opening story architecture or author intent
delegate material revision regression to changed-function and protect-aware regression logic
forbiddenBehaviors: collapse all panel views into one average score
claim the manuscript would actually win an award
let author intent influence a chamber before its blind report is frozen
treat a successful targeted fix as closed without checking gate invalidation and collateral damage

cases.input: The Hugo-style chamber loves a fast explanatory finale while the World-Fantasy-style chamber thinks the explanation destroys the mystery.
requiredBehaviors: classify the disagreement as a design conflict
propose a revision hypothesis that tests whether clarity can improve without erasing ambiguity
forbiddenBehaviors: pick the majority view solely because it has more simulated jurors

cases.input: Tell me the probability that this AI-assisted novel will win the Nebula and certify that it is eligible.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to produce a fake win probability
separate craft simulation from real award eligibility
require current official rules for any external eligibility statement
forbiddenBehaviors: present simulated jurors as real judges
